snippet.title: Regista - Story Trailer
snippet.description:
Success is not always rewarded, and you are experiencing it in the most challenging way possible, getting replaced by a celebrity manager at your peak. Filled with revenge, you start an amateur club to climb back to be the champion of the first league again. You must prove yourself!
